name: v0.8.226
body:
# HyperFrames v0.8.226

Released on 2026-11-01.

Safari keeps edited films' audio playing, and renders can pass a lone full-frame video straight through when you opt in. Apps that host Studio can show their own preview loader.

## Features

- **Producer:** Opt-in video layer passthrough for a lone full-canvas video ([98520366a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/98520366a6fccb0447a61f8e4baffa0f2568c359), [#6914](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6914)).
- **Studio:** A host that draws its own loader can turn off both of Studio's preview loaders ([a7075fcb6](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a7075fcb6c712e183736aac938d3ef57e8b12004), [#6911](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6911)).
- **Core:** WebKit plays bare audio from a decoded buffer on the audio clock ([e181d34ed](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e181d34edc45e2f9590007ebf7318f8a139bf747), [#6912](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6912)).
- **Core:** The playback health reading says which clock the film followed ([bba3676a3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/bba3676a3705e1e51a239899404f9982fca86951), [#6906](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6906)).

## Fixes

- **Core:** Safari keeps playing edits' audio without seeks or rate changes ([2c1a10f3a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2c1a10f3ad1fc2c356d3f9b4a4fd329a6900e806), [#6888](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6888)).
- **CLI:** Snapshot gives a seek that will not settle its own --timeout, not three minutes ([52a42983d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/52a42983db0e9b1db5d3ab0826f1686a09064462), [#6910](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6910)).
- **Engine:** Ffprobe read intervals never carry an exponent ([f486ad6d4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f486ad6d49c7c6880b83cad63ab99b764ba3bb36), [#6909](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6909)).
- **Producer:** A failed video extraction names which clip files failed ([32de0196d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/32de0196d59f73d1f7512315eac1acb88dfd9e42), [#6905](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6905)).
- **CLI:** Billing and Desktop handoff read their hosts from settings ([5ce6b30bd](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5ce6b30bdbe18d5351c67b168d0e057d16d1d48c), [#6897](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6897)).
- **Engine:** Scale static-frame verification budget with the job ([f3cdf2b47](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f3cdf2b4739d7012f67803668f47c5e22dd39408), [#6901](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6901)).
- **CLI:** Measure ink, one output-folder flag spelling, logo wordmark variant ([8a0b8a9c2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8a0b8a9c2224fc0fb4e9d239556fc63e7c6411d3), [#6891](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6891)).
- **Producer:** Render telemetry reports beyond-viewport capture as the workers used it ([bb3c3b211](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/bb3c3b211840b08ff8889e021320ba5962f0f6e6), [#6702](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6702)).
- **CLI:** One cut detector that tells real cuts from flashes and fast moves ([525909726](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5259097261a33c8c2aac8bcfa8c2a1b0eae5540f), [#6894](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6894)).
- **CLI:** Cloud render uses the composition's data-fps and skips unused heavy files ([ee50cd2fc](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ee50cd2fc0d0fe4a4eac22683ed23b6066289ab3), [#6895](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6895)).
- **Core:** A page saved as UTF-16 bundles as its text, not NUL bytes ([88f9ae846](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/88f9ae8468f0ce9b09efbdf29720aec0f2eb3207), [#6580](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6580)).

## Internal

- **Engine:** One builder for the video frame filter chain ([94849bf1e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/94849bf1e0b3bdc2d5eb118b82109e310c4215b1), [#6908](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6908)).
- Split the cli test job into two shards so each stays well under its limit ([a2c5a8a02](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a2c5a8a0245ef770695212c14f1f3f21d90bf78d), [#6902](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6902)).
- **Engine:** Run the non-PNG probe test on a fake clock ([ef0007b00](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ef0007b003384d321b90b7a9b7c0d4e06d014612), [#6907](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6907)).

## Full changelog

https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/compare/v0.8.225...v0.8.226

name: v0.8.225
body:
# HyperFrames v0.8.225

Released on 2026-10-31.

Exports no longer drop frames from nested video clips that start on a frame boundary. The CLI fills mask boxes from the picture behind, and billing top-up opens the pricing page.

## Fixes

- **Engine:** Nested video clips on a frame boundary export every source frame ([47fe68562](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/47fe68562f39d91b4d9280dff41ae43d67805fae), [#6893](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6893)).
- **CLI:** Billing top-up opens the pricing page ([4d44c0d0a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4d44c0d0ab459e4defad0954480a0798f353e421), [#6887](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6887)).
- **CLI:** Fill --mask boxes from the picture behind and crop generated clips to the requested aspect ([919e138fc](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/919e138fc25c5ae3dc6bc3ca46adc7f6b52cd0c8), [#6892](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6892)).

## Full changelog

https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/compare/v0.8.224...v0.8.225

name: v0.8.224
body:
# HyperFrames v0.8.224

Released on 2026-10-31.

Paid HyperFrames plans can render final cuts in the cloud at the composition's fps and high quality. Safari keeps audio smooth during playback, and Studio downloads exports larger than 2 GiB.

## Features

- **Skills:** Render final cuts in the cloud on a paid HyperFrames plan ([2b76e9a70](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2b76e9a70a749c445cd137946512b0dda8aa770f), [#6884](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6884)).

## Fixes

- **Skills:** Paid-plan cloud final keeps the composition fps and high quality ([6b0fd6d10](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6b0fd6d10992ebf5913dcc8418b7b8b58803f035), [#6886](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6886)).
- **CLI:** Stopping remove-background on a Mac no longer aborts the process ([ea7d43c61](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ea7d43c616c4cd3bb77f27eaf9f3becd32e41744), [#6848](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6848)).
- **Core:** A stuck seek in check or snapshot fails named before the protocol timeout ([1e5413f34](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1e5413f34ce489a1b35eaf46635a630a44cb5804), [#6596](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6596)).
- **Core:** Style a sub-composition root written as #root[data-composition-id] ([5c92fb077](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5c92fb07761cd0667d22380c2c855b89766f8fa4), [#6843](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6843)).
- **Studio Server:** Repeated splits stop stacking id CSS rules ([124a00f56](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/124a00f563944a006dd9ac286ecb91043b0fa0b9), [#6874](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6874)).
- **Producer:** Auto renders with color-graded media stay SDR instead of promoting to HDR ([60f711686](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/60f711686ccae602caaed24faa3e225be6d96b12), [#6671](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6671)).
- **Studio:** Preserve identity for stale metadata completions ([168429d51](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/168429d514ccefdfc5658138fb58426cf0e66e01), [#6755](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6755)).
- **Core:** Safari stops chopping audio by seeking it over and over during playback ([0c16afd94](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0c16afd949f2511ca17347eaa113640df0bac1e5), [#6854](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6854)).
- **Studio Server:** Download exports larger than 2 GiB ([164d6c7a3](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/164d6c7a36eba26e9126b364beab98437e2eeec7), [#6602](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6602)).

## Docs & Examples

- List OpenAI and Nate Herk as HyperFrames adopters ([a04b45a6d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a04b45a6db0d1f724be9cf1985c3b13657195f0d), [#6876](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6876)).

## Internal

- **CLI:** Proxy failure wording without added comments or a try/catch ([4d6d38519](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4d6d38519d06b650a5d4f55c5cc7ba854c0993ad), [#6715](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6715)).
- **Core:** Split the frozen-picture judgement so it stays under the complexity limit ([2bd8cd95c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2bd8cd95cb43fba47de906530e043900bb283371), [#6870](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6870)).

## Full changelog

name: v18.15.0
body:
## @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

### Fixed

- Fixed OpenAI remote compaction (`/responses/compact`) replaying backend-only `internal_chat_message_metadata_passthrough` metadata that Codex rejects as an unknown parameter ([#17590](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17590) by [@briankeefe](https://github.com/briankeefe))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-ai

### Fixed

- Fixed Codex conversation replay failing with an unknown `internal_chat_message_metadata_passthrough.content_token_count` parameter by omitting backend-internal response metadata from replayed input ([#17590](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17590), [#17597](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17597) by [@briankeefe](https://github.com/briankeefe)).
- Fixed `service_tier: "ultrafast"` being dropped for OpenAI-family models on custom providers even when the model's `serviceTiers` lists it ([#17577](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17577) by [@jakehemmerle](https://github.com/jakehemmerle))
- Fixed Google Vertex requests with Workforce Identity Federation ADC failing token refresh against the wrong endpoint ([#17447](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17447)).
- Fixed Anthropic (and other rotating-token) OAuth accounts being signed out automatically when a background usage poll's token refresh got `invalid_grant`, including refreshes a client delegates to an auth broker; usage polling no longer disables credentials, so only a real request's refresh can do that ([#17468](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17468))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

### Added

- Added Modular Cloud (`modular`) as a provider: `/login modular` with an API key, models and prices from the models.dev `modular` entry, and per-model reasoning controls for MiniMax M3.1 Flash, MiniMax M3, and Gemma 4 31B ([#17334](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17334) by [@tommyjtl](https://github.com/tommyjtl))
- SambaNova Cloud follow-up turns now reuse the provider's prefix cache, so multi-turn conversations stop re-processing earlier context ([#17555](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17555) by [@rjuez00](https://github.com/rjuez00))

### Fixed

- Fixed newly discovered OpenAI-compatible models ignoring provider-reported context and output token limits ([#17561](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17561) by [@wolfiesch](https://github.com/wolfiesch))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

### Added

- Long or multi-step background shell commands get a one-line caption saying what they do and when they end, written once per job by the `widget` model role when the job, after running 15 seconds, is shown in a live widget or listed by `/jobs full`; the jobs sheet and `/jobs full` show it under the job's purpose. It follows the Live Job Widgets setting (`async.widgets`), and `CreateAgentSessionOptions.jobCaptionWriter` replaces the model call ([#17649](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17649) by [@wolfiesch](https://github.com/wolfiesch))

### Changed

- In a source checkout, the error for a missing HTML export viewer now names the script that builds it, `packages/collab-web/scripts/build-export-viewer.ts`, beside `bun gen:export-viewer` ([#17636](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17636) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))
- Fixed an eval cell running silently on a new kernel after the session's Python kernel or JS worker died between cells (a crash, a kill, an out-of-memory kill, or a cancelled JS cell): the first cell on the replacement now carries `Kernel restarted: … state is unavailable. Re-run needed setup` ahead of its own output, instead of failing with a bare `NameError` on a variable an earlier cell set ([#17595](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17595) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))
- Fixed a task worker messaged (`write agent://<id>`) while still starting up running on the shared `context` alone and never receiving its `tasks[].task` assignment; the message now waits for the assignment's turn ([#17587](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17587))
- `lsp reload` now discovers Rust crates created after rust-analyzer started, so hover and other analysis work without restarting omp ([#17658](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17658)).
- A model without image input (GLM, DeepSeek, Grok Composer and the like) reads a snapcompact archive's full kept text instead of image-omitted placeholders for its frames, after a model switch, on resume and in side requests ([#17510](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17510) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Snapcompact no longer refuses a new archive as "would not reduce context" when it shrinks a session that already holds one (`/compact snapcompact`, idle and pre-prompt compaction) ([#17490](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17490) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- A failed `/compact snapcompact` now reports its reason once instead of twice, and names the `/compact` mode to run instead ([#17490](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17490) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Background bash and eval jobs now carry the purpose the model gave for the call: `/jobs`, `/jobs full`, `proc://` listings, `wait` and `job` results, and the jobs HUD hover lead with it ahead of the raw command line ([#17649](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17649) by [@wolfiesch](https://github.com/wolfiesch))
- The `seance` guidance in the task tool and the `archive` docs now say that a question about an earlier session is answered by the `seance` agent, and that reading the session's raw JSONL belongs to narrow mechanical checks only, so a consult is no longer duplicated by transcript reads and re-run checks ([#17523](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17523) by [@iacore](https://github.com/iacore))

### Fixed

- A prompt on a model whose provider has no usable credential (logged out, refresh token expired, or an auth broker holding none) now switches to the first `retry.fallbackChains` candidate that has one instead of failing with "No API key found", and switches back on the first prompt after the credential returns ([#17559](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17559) by [@wolfiesch](https://github.com/wolfiesch))
- Fixed background results arriving during manual `/compact` starting turns on stale history or disappearing from the saved session ([#17599](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17599)).
- Fixed isolated tasks on fuse-overlayfs leaving their overlay mounted and the `fuse-overlayfs` daemon running when the unmount hit a transient "Device or resource busy"; a failed unmount now reports fusermount's error and keeps the workspace for `omp worktree clear` instead of deleting its layers under the live mount ([#17644](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17644))
- Usage-limit retries now count system sleep toward the quota-reset deadline instead of re-arming the remaining uptime delay after the countdown reaches zero ([#17606](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17606) by [@zhiland](https://github.com/zhiland)).
- Fixed role assignments to a `models.yml` model whose id differs only by case from a bundled model of the same provider (such as `xiaomi/MiMo-V2.6-Pro` beside `xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-pro`) silently staying unset ([#17580](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17580))
- Fixed Eval's direct browser wait helpers (`tab.waitForSelector`, `tab.waitForText`, …) giving up after 29 s when passed a longer `{ timeout }`; the requested timeout is now honored up to the browser tool's 300 s cap ([#17617](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17617))
- Fixed `browser.open` with a fresh custom Chrome profile failing when Chrome has no initial tabs; it now opens its own tab without navigating an existing one ([#17583](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17583)).
- Fixed the read tool's repeated-output notice suggesting a `path:A-B` selector on `xd://` topics, MCP resources and other URLs that reject selectors ([#17631](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17631))
- The `lsp` tool now starts `typescript-native` (`tsc --lsp --stdio`) for a TypeScript 7 `tsc` installed without a `package.json`, such as the nixpkgs package, instead of leaving the project with no TypeScript server ([#17659](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17659))
- DuckDuckGo excludes advertising click redirects before applying result limits, keeping them out of direct and Public Web sources ([#17564](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17564) by [@jasonharrison](https://github.com/jasonharrison)).
- Fixed `/fast` refusing Ultrafast ("The current model does not offer the Ultrafast service tier") on custom OpenAI-compatible providers whose `/v1/models` row lists `ultrafast` in `service_tiers`, such as relays in front of a ChatGPT subscription ([#17577](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17577) by [@jakehemmerle](https://github.com/jakehemmerle))
- Importing the SDK no longer takes over the embedding host's signal and fatal-error shutdown; registered cleanup still runs at exit ([#17674](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17674)).
- Fixed raw browser `page.waitForFunction` waits timing out after a full-document navigation even when the destination matches the predicate ([#17584](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17584))
- Fixed a Ctrl+R history entry picked while an ask dialog's "Other" or note prompt is open landing in the hidden main chat input instead of that prompt ([#17565](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17565))
- Bash commands no longer hang on `git rebase -i` when git config sets a `sequence.editor` (an inline `GIT_SEQUENCE_EDITOR=…` still wins), or on Git Credential Manager GUI/browser sign-in prompts ([#17452](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17452) by [@wolfiesch](https://github.com/wolfiesch))
- Fixed intercepted bash commands asking for approval before being blocked anyway ([#17502](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17502) by [@asuffield](https://github.com/asuffield))
- Fixed `omp --from-claude` listing a Claude Code session renamed with `/rename` by its first prompt; the picker now shows the renamed title and importing the session keeps it ([#17361](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17361) by [@namest504](https://github.com/namest504)).
- Auto-learn capture turns now reuse the main turn's prompt cache instead of re-sending the whole conversation uncached: they advertise the same tool list and refuse every call except `learn` and `manage_skill` without running it ([#17418](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17418) by [@STRML](https://github.com/STRML)).
- Fixed extensions being unable to replace the background-job completion card with `registerMessageRenderer("async-result", …)`; a registered renderer now owns the card, and the built-in row remains the fallback when none is registered, when one declines, and when one throws ([#17372](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17372) by [@AlexBrd999](https://github.com/AlexBrd999), from [#14484](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14484) by [@F0Rextasy](https://github.com/F0Rextasy); [#14131](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/14131))
- Local dictation stops live previews when the speech model repeatedly cannot keep up, so final transcripts no longer wait behind repeated previews ([#17410](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17410)).
- ACP clients now receive `_omp/compaction/start` and `_omp/compaction/end` notifications, including failures and cancellations, without requiring an active prompt. ([#16969](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16969); [#17384](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17384) by [@SAKANA-MOONLIGHT](https://github.com/SAKANA-MOONLIGHT)).
- Fixed `cd` (and `pushd`/`popd`/`z`) failing with `command not found: __zsh_like_cd` in agent shells when `mise activate` or `zoxide init` installed wrapper functions: the shell snapshot now keeps the underscore-prefixed helper functions those wrappers call, instead of dropping every private-looking function ([#17448](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17448) by [@KamijoToma](https://github.com/KamijoToma))

## @oh-my-pi/collab-web

### Changed

- `job` tool results name each background job by the purpose the model gave for it, falling back to its command ([#17649](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17649) by [@wolfiesch](https://github.com/wolfiesch))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-natives

### Fixed

- Fixed the bash tool's shell stopping with status 1 and no message after about 40 levels of nested functions, `eval` or `source` when the process may open only 1,024 files; a shell that runs out of open files now says so and names the limit to raise ([#17668](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17668) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))
- `bun check` now runs the Rust half when your branch commits a Rust change on a clean tree, skips it on a TypeScript-only branch even under `CI=true`, and prints one line saying which it did and why (`OMP_FORCE_RUST_TASKS=1` always runs it) ([#17628](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17628) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))

## @oh-my-pi/snapcompact

### Added

- Added `viewWithoutFrames`: what a reader without image input reads for an archive, its kept text in place of its frames ([#17510](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17510) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-tui

### Breaking Changes

- `GroupedLineContext.isUrl` is replaced by `url`, the internal URL a header names or a body row belongs to ([#17608](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17608) by [@JustasMasiulis](https://github.com/JustasMasiulis))

### Added

- Added `FILE_NAME_COLOR`, `formatStyledPath` and `pathNameStart` to `render/render-utils` for paths in tool bodies and Tern file rows; `createGroupedRowStyler`, `groupedLinkTargets`, `fitGroupsToBudget`, `groupsByFile` and `isMatchRow` to `tools/grouped-file-output`; `splitReadQuery` to `tools/read`; and `HASHLINE_TAG_SUFFIX_RE` to `tools/hashline-format`. `classifyGroupedLines` reports each file header's full `displayPath` and `suffix`, and a `TranscriptStatusPart` without `color` keeps its already-styled text ([#17608](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17608) by [@JustasMasiulis](https://github.com/JustasMasiulis))
- `JobsPanelJob.caption`: the jobs sheet's detail pane shows it, muted, between the job's purpose and its command (`omp.jobs.caption`) ([#17649](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17649) by [@wolfiesch](https://github.com/wolfiesch))

### Changed

- The Background jobs sheet names each job by what it is for when the model said so, shows that above the full command in the detail pane, and no longer repeats the command in an empty widget box for jobs that print nothing ([#17649](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17649) by [@wolfiesch](https://github.com/wolfiesch))
- File paths in tool output share one style: a dim directory and the file name in the custom-message label color (bronze in titanium), with line locations and selectors (`:1-175`, `:42:14`, `?q=`) muted. This covers Grep, AST Grep, AST Edit, Glob, Find, LSP, diagnostics, grouped Reads and file mentions; Glob's folder icon is muted like the file-type icons, and paths in tool headers keep their color ([#17608](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17608) by [@JustasMasiulis](https://github.com/JustasMasiulis))
- Grep, AST Grep and AST Edit results label each file with its full path instead of the model-facing `# dir/` and `## file#tag` headers, and each file gets its own tree branch. Their collapsed previews fit the same row budget the same way, cutting the last file short rather than overflowing, and end with `… N more matches` (`… N more files` for AST Edit) ([#17608](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17608) by [@JustasMasiulis](https://github.com/JustasMasiulis))
- AST Grep match rows link to their line, as Grep's do ([#17608](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17608) by [@JustasMasiulis](https://github.com/JustasMasiulis))
- LSP diagnostics carry their severity color on the `[error]`/`[warning]` tag instead of the location, and collapsed diagnostic rows now show that tag ([#17608](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17608) by [@JustasMasiulis](https://github.com/JustasMasiulis))

### Fixed

- Rex sessions now render Kitty graphics without forcing the protocol, including when only `TERM=xterm-rex` identifies the client ([#17651](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17651)).
- Fixed collapsed AST Grep showing no matches when its first file or folder was taller than the preview, and its `… N more` row counting hidden folders instead of hidden matches ([#17608](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17608) by [@JustasMasiulis](https://github.com/JustasMasiulis))
- Fixed collapsed AST Edit overflowing its preview when the first file's diff was long ([#17608](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17608) by [@JustasMasiulis](https://github.com/JustasMasiulis))
- Fixed search and diagnostic file paths in Tern dropping the leading `/` of absolute paths and a folder's own `(…)` ending, and AST Edit diffs in Tern losing highlighting to the file's `#tag`; a file name ending in lowercase or other-length `#…` text keeps it ([#17608](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17608) by [@JustasMasiulis](https://github.com/JustasMasiulis))
- Fixed a read of a URL drawing as dead text in the folded read row: its target is not a file path, so no link was built for it, and clicking the URL did nothing. The row (and each row of a grouped read) now links to the URL itself, gaining an `https://` scheme for a bare `www.` host ([#17598](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17598) by [@iacore](https://github.com/iacore))
- Fixed replayed transcripts ignoring a registered `async-result` message renderer, so a replayed conversation rendered differently from the live one ([#17372](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17372) by [@AlexBrd999](https://github.com/AlexBrd999), from [#14484](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14484) by [@F0Rextasy](https://github.com/F0Rextasy); [#14131](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/14131))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-utils

### Added

- Added abortable `sleepUntil` for wall-clock deadline waits that include system sleep, with bounded timer slices to recheck deadlines after resume ([#17606](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17606) by [@zhiland](https://github.com/zhiland)).

### Fixed

- Importing pi-utils no longer installs process-wide signal and fatal handlers in embedding hosts; exit-time cleanup stays installed ([#17674](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17674)).


## What's Changed

* feat(tui): share one path style in tool bodies and label search files by full path by @JustasMasiulis in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17608
* feat(coding-agent): name background jobs by their purpose and caption long commands by @wolfiesch in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17649

name: v18.14.2
body:
## @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

### Added

- The soft steering signal a tool sees as `toolCall.steeringSignal` now aborts with the source of the queued message (`"user"`, `"irc"`, …) as its `reason`, so a tool can yield only to the sources it should ([#17537](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17537))

### Fixed

- Reject incomplete local compaction, turn-prefix, handoff, and branch summaries ending with `stopReason: "length"` instead of using truncated text as complete context. Omit incomplete display-only short summaries without discarding a completed full summary ([#17499](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17499) by [@Xytronix](https://github.com/Xytronix)).

## @oh-my-pi/pi-ai

### Breaking Changes

- Replaced `isLoopGuardedModel` with `loopGuardLevel`, which returns `"off"`, `"exact"`, or `"semantic"` from the model's `thinking-loop-guard` catalog rule

### Added

- Added `disableServerSideFallback` to `FactoryDroidOptions` and `SimpleStreamOptions`: a Factory Droid request leaves out the server-side refusal fallback chain and fails, before any of its content is streamed, if another model answers it ([#12229](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/12229) by [@Xytronix](https://github.com/Xytronix))

### Changed

- DeepSeek and Grok models on Amazon Bedrock now get the same near-duplicate reasoning-loop checks as on other hosts

### Fixed

- Fixed Claude turns failing with "Thinking loop detected" when summarized thinking repeated a progress line such as "Still writing the parser..."; Claude models no longer run the loop guard
- Fixed the loop guard discarding turns from other models whose reasoning summary repeats one status line a few times; whole-line repetition now has to cover about 1 KB before it counts as a loop
- Fixed per-request OpenAI-compatible headers being combined with differently cased model headers instead of overriding them ([#17513](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17513) by [@jchanghong023](https://github.com/jchanghong023))
- Fixed a stalled Anthropic stream that keeps sending empty content deltas never timing out, because those deltas were treated as stream progress ([#17484](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17484) by [@jchanghong023](https://github.com/jchanghong023))
- Fixed Anthropic-compatible endpoints that put a thinking signature on the streamed content block losing it, so replayed reasoning keeps its signed block ([#17483](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17483) by [@jchanghong023](https://github.com/jchanghong023))
- Fixed `AuthStorage.close()` and `replaceStore()` losing a rotated OAuth refresh token when a refresh was still in flight, with or without durable refresh leases; the store now stays open until that token is saved, and new refreshes are refused ([#17518](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17518))
- Fixed `/usage` showing Cursor's "Other Models" meter as an inflated dollar amount; it now shows the percentage Cursor reports, like Cursor Models ([#17462](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17462) by [@eggpeat](https://github.com/eggpeat))
- Fixed the `omp auth-gateway` Responses endpoint rejecting documented null values for temperature, `top_p`, output limits, reasoning, and reasoning summaries ([#17466](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17466) by [@Xytronix](https://github.com/Xytronix)).
- Fixed provider HTTP errors printing the response body twice when the thrown error already carried it, including responses with a retry header ([#17503](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17503) by [@metaphoric-dev](https://github.com/metaphoric-dev))
- Fixed Gemini tool calls through the `omp auth-gateway` chat-completions endpoint failing on the next turn: the gateway now returns each call's thought signature in `extra_content` and replays the one a client sends back ([#17509](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17509) by [@justdoGIT](https://github.com/justdoGIT))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

### Breaking Changes

- Removed `thinkingLoopGuard` from compat records; `thinking-loop-guard` is now a catalog axis that applies on every host, with `"semantic"` for Gemini, DeepSeek, and Grok and `"off"` for Claude

### Fixed

- Fixed GitHub Copilot Claude 5.x base models (`claude-opus-5`, `claude-opus-5.5`, `claude-sonnet-5`, `claude-sonnet-5.5`) reporting the 1M window of their `-1m` variants once the model list was read from cache; discovered limits now survive cached reads instead of reverting to bundled values ([#17481](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17481))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

### Added

- Added `task.perCallModel` (`off` by default, `eval`, `on`) so a task item or an eval `agent()`/`workpool()` call can run on one exact model the operator already names: a chat role from your own (non-project) settings, the selected agent's own model, or the parent's current model. Glob values (`anthropic/*`) never approve a model. `task.perCallModelAllow` narrows that list, `task.maxEffort` caps the worker's effort, and the worker never switches to another model. Project settings can only narrow this: they never turn it on or approve a model ([#12229](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/12229) by [@Xytronix](https://github.com/Xytronix))
- Added `Settings.reloadFromDisk({ includeParents: true })`, which reloads the persisted settings behind an overlay while keeping the overlay's own overrides ([#12229](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/12229) by [@Xytronix](https://github.com/Xytronix))

### Changed

- `model` is now declared in every task schema: a task call, eval `agent()` or `workpool()` that passes a model the operator's configuration does not allow is refused with an error ([#12229](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/12229) by [@Xytronix](https://github.com/Xytronix))
- Viewing a subagent or returning to the main session no longer posts a "Viewing agent …" / "Returned to main session" status (a popup in Tern); the status line and Tern's composer already show which agent is in view
- In a Tern pane, `omp stats` shows the dashboard in place of the block it runs in, with a Close button (or Esc, or Ctrl+C) that stops it and brings the terminal back, and `/stats` opens it in a browser block beside omp, instead of the system browser
- `bash` tool commands now see `PI_TOOL_CALL_ID`, the id of the call running them, so a script the agent runs can point at that call in the session transcript ([#17489](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17489) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Native judgments with a configured fallback now move to it after a 3-second candidate deadline (configurable with `judgment.attemptTimeoutMs`) and briefly skip the timed-out route; without a configured fallback a slow judge is never cut off or replaced ([#17465](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17465) by [@Xytronix](https://github.com/Xytronix)).

### Fixed

- Fixed a `!` or `$` command run while the agent works floating over the composer in Tern, where expanding its output covered the conversation; it now sits at the end of the conversation
- Fixed `out://` replies sent from an eval cell (`tool.write` to `out://`, or `tool.bash` with `> out://`) never appearing even though the write reported "Shown to the user."; they now draw as replies after the eval card, and are refused where nothing would show them (a backgrounded cell, a browser tab script)
- Fixed a `write` to `out://` (such as `out://baselines.md`) drawing as a Write card with line numbers instead of a reply streaming as prose
- Fixed table charts drawing a `ratio` or `speedup` column as a series beside the timings it was computed from, which read as "719× less" against the baseline
- Fixed `read` of a directory hiding existing `dist`, `build`, `node_modules`, `.git`, and other dependency/build/cache subdirectories, which made them look absent ([#17539](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17539))
- Fixed artifact writes reporting the staging-file cleanup error instead of the original short-write or publication failure ([#17485](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17485) by [@jchanghong023](https://github.com/jchanghong023))
- Fixed MCP tool calls failing without reconnecting after DNS or socket-open errors ([#17461](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17461) by [@Xytronix](https://github.com/Xytronix)).
- Fixed MCP connection timeouts and cancellation allowing a stdio server to start after the connection attempt had already failed. ([#17512](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17512) by [@jchanghong023](https://github.com/jchanghong023))
- Fixed ACP updates and extension dialogs switching to an unadvertised session handle after a session reset, and a client reopening a continued conversation after a restart landing on the original session ([#17517](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17517) by [@jchanghong023](https://github.com/jchanghong023))
- Fixed IRC coordination cards remaining visible when Hide Tool Activity is enabled, including live messages and replay ([#17498](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17498) by [@dannyboy-ai](https://github.com/dannyboy-ai)).
- Fixed a message you queue while the agent waits on `ask` sitting behind the unanswered dialog; the dialog now closes without cancelling the turn, while IRC messages and background completions leave it open ([#17537](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17537)).
- Fixed JS eval `output()` ignoring its documented `offset`, `limit`, `query` and `format` options and returning the raw `read` tool result; it now returns the selected text (or the `format: "json"` metadata) like Python's `output()` ([#17455](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17455))
- Fixed session lookup losing readable project sessions when an unrelated project folder is unreadable ([#17467](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17467) by [@Xytronix](https://github.com/Xytronix)).
- Fixed the advisor resending a byte-identical refused review before trying its model fallback when the review contained no primary reasoning to strip ([#17473](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17473))
- Fixed `read` of a whole URL returning no content when the page's first line is over the 50 KB output budget, as on minified pages read with `:raw`; it now shows that line's first 50 KB ([#17500](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17500) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed an advisor whose usage-limited account kept being reported as switchable retrying the same capped account thousands of times; it now tries each sibling account at most once per provider per failing review, then falls back, waits, or pauses on the quota ([#17472](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17472))
- Fixed LSP definition, type definition, implementation and reference results carrying a stray carriage return on every source context line from files with Windows (CRLF) line endings ([#17549](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17549) by [@JustasMasiulis](https://github.com/JustasMasiulis))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-mnemopi

### Fixed

- Fixed heuristic episodic facts storing word fragments (`Drafting is active.` → `ctive`), truncated multiword objects, or nothing for `has an …` sentences ([#17511](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17511))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-natives

### Added

- Added `listWorkspace({ pruneExcludedDirs: false })` to stop pruning standard dependency/build directory names; hidden directories such as `.git` also require `hidden: true` ([#17539](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/17539))

## @oh-my-pi/omp-stats

### Added

- Added `setStatsCloseHandler`: while a host sets one, the dashboard shows a Close button in its top bar and closes on Esc or Ctrl+C (with no text selected), for hosts that show it in place of their terminal

### Fixed

- Fixed tool error rates counting skipped tool calls that were explicitly marked as not executed ([#17463](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17463) by [@Xytronix](https://github.com/Xytronix)).

## @oh-my-pi/pi-tui

### Added

- Added `assertModelSupportsEffortCeiling()`, which throws when a model has no supported thinking effort at or below a `task.maxEffort` ceiling ([#12229](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/12229) by [@Xytronix](https://github.com/Xytronix))
- Added `iconButton()`, `quietButton()` and `segmentedTabs()` to `native/overlay`, and `disabled`, `busy` and `icon` options to `actionButton()`
- Added `nativeTail` to `Composer.setRuntimeChildren` options: containers whose children continue the native surface's `main` after the transcript instead of riding in the dock
- Added `isHighlightLanguage` and `createCodeFrameStyler` for renderers that highlight source lines in their file's language ([#17550](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17550) by [@JustasMasiulis](https://github.com/JustasMasiulis))

### Changed

- Grep and read results with gaps between line runs now render in Tern as one code block that scrolls sideways as a whole, with `…` gap rows aligned in the line-number gutter
- Tern builds that draw the `button` kind get omp's buttons as real buttons (pointer cursor, accessible pressed/disabled state, a disabled button's tooltip says why) and segmented controls as `tabs` `variant: "segmented"`; older Tern builds keep the role-styled rows
- Source lines in Grep, AST Grep and Find results and LSP symbol names are syntax-highlighted in their file's language instead of drawn in one color; consecutive lines highlight together, so multi-line strings and comments keep their colors ([#17550](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17550) by [@JustasMasiulis](https://github.com/JustasMasiulis))

### Fixed

- Fixed table charts plotting a ratio column against the timings it divides (`ratio` 0.997 beside `C++ (ms)` drew as "719× less"): `analyzeTable` reads a column equal to the quotient of two others as restating them, written bare or as `×`
- Fixed IRC coordination cards remaining visible when Hide Tool Activity is enabled, including incoming messages, automatic replies, relays, and workpool messages in live and replayed transcripts ([#17498](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17498) by [@dannyboy-ai](https://github.com/dannyboy-ai)).
- Fixed text after a nested color losing the outer color, such as the rest of the `/mcp` and `/ssh` hints after the highlighted command (`Run /mcp list to see all configured servers.`) falling back to the default text color instead of staying muted ([#17521](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17521) by [@JustasMasiulis](https://github.com/JustasMasiulis))
- Fixed LSP definition, type definition and implementation results showing the raw `Found 1 definition(s):` text; the response now counts them (`1 definition`) and shows each location over its source lines, its own line marked like a grep match ([#17549](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17549) by [@JustasMasiulis](https://github.com/JustasMasiulis))
- Fixed an LSP definition, type definition or implementation location whose path starts with whitespace being dropped, with its source lines shown under the previous location
- Fixed session tree user and assistant turns looking identical in themes whose `accent` and `success` colors match or nearly match (`dark-terminal`, `dark-poimandres`, `light-poimandres`): user rows are now bold, the `assistant:` label switches to the path color, and custom and advisor messages are muted ([#17520](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17520) by [@wolfiesch](https://github.com/wolfiesch))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-utils

### Added

- Added `oklabDistance`, the perceptual distance between two hex colors ([#17520](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17520))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-wire

### Added

- Added `nums` to `code` props (`TspCodeProps`): each line's number, so one block can show non-contiguous lines with `…` gap rows where the numbers jump.

name: Reasonix Studio v2.56.1
body:
本版是修复版：收紧只读命令判定中 `python -v` 的漏洞，限制模型同时打开的网页数量，并修复手机窄屏布局、定时运行按钮空白、待发送区误显示按钮、中文路径导致会话读不出等问题。

## 变更

- 工作区在网络盘（如 SMB 映射盘）上时，运行无法判断写入范围的命令前的目录遍历改为并发读取，大目录树上等待大幅缩短。关联 #14813。
- 启动环境摘要优先复用当前数据目录的可信快照，避免其他目录的探测结果改变系统提示、降低首次请求的缓存命中率。修复 #14676 by @SivanCola。

## 修复

- 安全：只读命令判定现在只把 `node` 和 `python` 单独的版本探针（如 `python3 -V`）当作只读；`python3 -v 脚本` 这类会运行代码的调用需要批准。关联 #14886。
- 模型同时打开的网页上限为 12 个，超过时会提示它先关闭用完的页面，避免一次搜索开出几十个页面占用数 GB 内存；你自己打开的页面不受限。修复 #14844 fixed in #14866。
- 手机窄屏：侧栏菜单按钮不再紧贴标志；设置页「关闭」与放大按钮并排，设置标签按内容宽度排列。修复 #14865 fixed in #14873、#14867 fixed in #14873、#14868 fixed in #14873。
- 「自动化 → 定时运行」的「预览」和「确认创建」按钮不再显示为空白。修复 #14870 fixed in #14871。
- 待发送区里已被当前轮接收的插话只显示「立即发送」与「取回」，不再出现点了就报"当前状态不允许此操作"的「改」和移动按钮。修复 #14875 fixed in #14877。
- 会话的分支信息含中文路径时，不再因编码误判丢掉反斜杠、导致整个会话读不出来。关联 #14841 by @ShryukGrandhi。
- 内置浏览器拾取元素时，属性名按属性值同样的上限裁剪。关联 #14580、#14849 by @jf200s。
- `/migrate` 读不到旧会话目录时会报出目录和原因，不再说没有需要迁移的会话。关联 #14823 by @chuiwenwei。
- `doctor repair` 读不到配置时报告 unreadable 并以非零退出，`--apply` 不再改写它；`doctor runtime` 没有可询问的 runtime 时显示 unknown。关联 #14824 by @chuiwenwei、#14825 by @chuiwenwei。
- 完成报告、步骤提示和能力诊断里截断的中文等多字节文字不再出现半个字符。关联 #14842 by @kevin9327、#14843 by @kevin9327、#14851 by @kevin9327。

## 贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@SivanCola、@ShryukGrandhi、@jf200s、@chuiwenwei、@kevin9327

---

<!-- lang:en -->

## Changed

- With the workspace on a network drive such as an SMB share, the walk before an unclassified command reads concurrently, much faster on big trees. Refs #14813.
- Startup summaries prefer the current data home's trusted snapshot, so another directory's probe no longer changes the system prompt and cold-starts the cache. Fixes #14676 by @SivanCola.

## Fixed

- Security: the read-only check treats only a bare `node` or `python` version probe (such as `python3 -V`) as a read; `python3 -v script` and other calls that run code need approval. Refs #14886.
- The model can have at most 12 pages open; past that it is asked to close finished ones, so one search no longer opens dozens. Your own pages are not limited. Fixes #14844 fixed in #14866.
- On a phone, the sidebar menu button no longer touches the logo, Settings puts Close beside expand, and its tabs fit their content. Fixes #14865 fixed in #14873, #14867 fixed in #14873, #14868 fixed in #14873.
- The "Preview" and "Confirm" buttons of Automation → Scheduled runs no longer show blank. Fixes #14870 fixed in #14871.
- Guidance the running turn already accepted shows only send-now and withdraw in the pending panel, not the edit and move buttons that always failed. Fixes #14875 fixed in #14877.
- A branch record holding a CJK path no longer loses a backslash to a wrong charset guess, which made the whole session unreadable. Refs #14841 by @ShryukGrandhi.
- When the built-in browser picks an element, attribute names are clipped to the same limit as values. Refs #14580, #14849 by @jf200s.
- `/migrate` names the directory and the cause when it cannot read the legacy sessions, instead of saying there was nothing to migrate. Refs #14823 by @chuiwenwei.
- `doctor repair` reports an unreadable config and exits non-zero, `--apply` leaves it alone; `doctor runtime` says unknown with no runtime to ask. Refs #14824 by @chuiwenwei, #14825 by @chuiwenwei.
- Multi-byte text cut in completion reports, step hints and capability diagnostics no longer ends in half a character. Refs #14842 by @kevin9327, #14843 by @kevin9327, #14851 by @kevin9327.

## Contributors

Thanks to this release's contributors: @SivanCola, @ShryukGrandhi, @jf200s, @chuiwenwei, @kevin9327

## What's Changed
* fix(ci): set up pnpm before the Node cache that needs it in the Android workflow by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14811
* fix(ci): run the Android scripts through bash and build the kernel at the tag's version by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14812
* fix(ci): the Android page check writes its token file owner-only by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14814
* perf(agent): read the criteria walk's directories and files concurrently by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14813
* ci(android): let the workflow build a branch as a trial run that publishes nothing by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14817
* fix(android): verify the two POMs the Gradle classpath needs on CI, and store the file with LF by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14819
* fix(android): verify the Linux aapt2 jar the CI build resolves by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14820
* fix(boot): preserve environment snapshot precedence / 保持环境探测快照前缀稳定 by @SivanCola in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14676
* fix(android): verify the 24 artifacts the release lint task resolves on CI by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14821
* fix(doctor): a runtime nobody can ask is not clean by @chuiwenwei in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14825
* fix(sessionstore): decode the branch-meta sidecar as UTF-8 before transcoding by @ShryukGrandhi in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14841
* fix(evidence): cut a cited command in a rejection message on a rune boundary by @kevin9327 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14842
* fix(complete_step): cut listed commands in the citation hint on a rune boundary by @kevin9327 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14843
* fix(doctor): an unreadable config is not a missing one by @chuiwenwei in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14824
* feat(studio): pick an element in the built-in browser by @jf200s in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14795
* fix(studio): clip attribute keys like their values by @jf200s in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14849
* ci(windows): give the full push suite room for a slow boot package by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14848
* fix(migrate): an unreadable source is not an empty one by @chuiwenwei in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14823
* test(migration): skip the unreadable-source cases where the platform cannot build one by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14850
* fix(capdiag): cap sanitized diagnostic text on a rune boundary by @kevin9327 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14851
* fix(browser): bound the pages the agent can have open at once by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14866
* fix(studio): a primary button in settings keeps its fill with its foreground by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14871
* fix(studio): phone-width spacing for the sidebar logo and the Settings header by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14873
* fix(queue): draw edit and move only on lines the kernel can still change by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14877
* fix(shellsafe): read-only only for a bare node or python version probe by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14886
* docs(release): studio 2.56.1 notes by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14887


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/compare/studio-v2.56.0...studio-v2.56.1


---

**macOS** 已用 Developer ID 签名并公证，打开时不需要清除隔离属性。**Windows** 的窗口、内核与安装器都经 Certum 代码签名证书做了 Authenticode 签名。**Linux** Debian 系从 `.deb` 安装，Fedora、RHEL、openSUSE 等从 `.rpm` 安装（`sudo dnf install ./ReasonixStudio-linux-amd64.rpm`）。x86_64 用文件名带 amd64 的包，aarch64（统信 UOS、麒麟等）用带 arm64 的包。也提供 `.AppImage`（只提供下载，不会自更新；需要 FUSE 2，或用 `--appimage-extract-and-run` 启动）。

三个平台都能自更新：Linux 的 `.deb` 走自己的包（`.rpm` 的自更新尚未提供，请手动下载新包），Windows 运行下一个安装器，macOS 替换自身 bundle。

name: fresh-editor 0.5.7
body:
## 0.5.7

For live updates on Fresh, [follow me on X](https://x.com/TheNoamLewis).

> Most config options below can be changed in the **Settings UI** - run **Open Settings** from the command palette (`Ctrl+P`).

### Features

* **Compare Files** - `fresh --diff A B` shows any two files side by side, both editable (#3611, requested by @cherio)
* **Universal Search across all workspaces** - toggle **All workspaces** (`Alt+A`) to search every local workspace's files, unsaved buffers and terminals; Enter jumps there (#3654)
* **`fresh --update`** - alias for `fresh --cmd update`, which now asks before installing instead of looking like a finished update (#3064, #3614, reported by @davidwooff)
* **`Shift+Home` selects to the first non-blank character** first, then column 0, like `Home` - new `select_smart_home` action (#3585, #3669, requested by @notnout)
* **Nix installation noted on the homepage** (#3635, by @dwt)

### Bug Fixes

* **Idle CPU, memory and log growth from `git_statusbar` on Linux** - file reads no longer count as changes, which re-ran `git` several times a second (#3607, #3659, reported by @naoto-anzai)
* **Search & Replace honours Case Sensitive and Whole Word** (#3575, #3640, reported by @Korkman)
* **Unsaved work is kept in one place whatever the launch mode** - one buffer per file, saves refuse to overwrite a file another Fresh has open, sudo saves are crash-safe, and switching workspaces keeps your tab in front (#3633, #3639, #3660)
* **Hot exit entries are replaced atomically by a save** (#3626, #3627)
* **Undo restores the exact bytes of a deleted non-UTF-8 byte** instead of writing U+FFFD on save (#3652, #3655)
* **Sudo-saving a new file** no longer creates it with mode 000 (#3641, #3653, reported by @ViolinKaine)
* **Files over SSH are writable** when the remote user owns them, even if local and remote UIDs differ (#2944, #3669, reported by @mommysgoodpuppy)
* **Ctrl+V in a terminal pane reaches the program when the clipboard has no text**, so agent CLIs can paste images; turn off with `terminal.pass_ctrl_v_without_text` (#3129, #3658, reported by @andreivinca)
* **Typing in long wrapped lines** is one frame per key and no longer stutters (#3631, #3632, reported by @jmote)
* **Home, End, Up and Down after fast typing** land in the right place (#3642, #3656)
* **Replace-all on huge files** uses far less memory (#3642, #3657)
* **Orchestrator picker returns the keyboard to the dock only if it had it**, so arrow keys no longer reach a terminal shell (#3136, #3661)
* **Terminal fixes**
    * macOS clipboard errors no longer paint over the screen (#3662, #3664, reported by @mruff-aeq)
    * kitty keyboard protocol is enabled for clients attached to the daemon, so Super shortcuts work (#3618, #3640, reported by @S-AM-I)
* **Exported Bash functions survive environment capture** (#3586, #3640, reported by @warrenfalk)
* **A workspace file that exists but can't be opened keeps its place in the layout** (#3532, #3640)
* **Ctrl+P list fits on short terminals** instead of covering the input line (#3578, #3669)
* **View menu Line Numbers / Line Wrap** show the real setting on terminal and Welcome tabs and are greyed out there (#3550, #3669, reported by @sjsepan3)
* **Status bar shows "Bash"** instead of "Bourne Again Shell (bash)" (#2727, #3669, reported by @720720)
* **Palette hint bar colors** follow the selected-row foreground, so themes are easier to style (#3616, #3653, reported by @Korkman)
* **Search & replace polish** - Unicode word highlights, replace within a multi-line selection, cheaper recovery for large replace-alls, accurate Live Grep over terminals (#3645, #3648)
* **Markdown Source/Compose scroll sync** no longer drifts or stalls (#3609)
* **Plugin panels recolor** when rewritten to text of the same length (#3646, #3647)
* **Macros with plugin-bound keys** replay once and in order, without timer ticks (#3595, #3597)
* **`fresh --diff` opens without an empty-editor flash** and scrolls smoothly (#3630)
* **Docs** - tabs vs spaces, `auto_revert_poll_interval_ms`, and the rendering architecture are corrected (#3114, #3272, #3599, #3669, #3653; #3114 reported by @sgon00)

### Internals

* **Plugin API** - `runOnTarget` / a machine's `run` replaces the deprecated `spawnProcess`; plugin calls can target another workspace; plugin commands from a hook apply as one batch (#3637, #3654)
* Debian packaging, CI sharding and advisory fixes, dependency bumps, flaky-test fixes (#3593, #3596, #3604, #3605, #3606, #3629, #3650, #3651)

name: v5.1.56
body:
Distrusted intermediate certificates under an allowed root are not yet blocked; tracked upstream. ([#11956](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11956))

Engines started by the OmO desktop app, or by an OmO server you start yourself, no longer read `SSL_CERT_FILE` or `SSL_CERT_DIR`. If your root certificate is only in such a file, install it in your operating system's certificate store, or add it in the desktop app under Settings, Extra CA certificates. A server you start yourself also keeps honoring `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS`. ([#11956](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11956))

On Linux, OmO now trusts only your distribution's generated certificate bundle. A root placed directly in `/etc/ssl/certs` or `/etc/ssl/cert.pem` without running `update-ca-certificates` or `update-ca-trust` is no longer trusted; install it with that tool. If OmO cannot read your operating system's certificates, the failed request says why and what to do. ([#11956](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11956))

The last sentence describes the completed rollout; its transport-error explanation is a later increment and is not enabled by this launcher-only change. ([#11956](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11956))

### Fixed

- Memory git hooks no longer initialize unrelated supervisor modules before checking staged notes, preserving validation. The startup cut applies to the source runtime (tests and dev), where one pre-commit hook took about 3.7 s; the packaged plugin bundle already deferred module initialisation, and its hook-mode time was measured unchanged (about 133-151 ms before and after). ([#11957](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11957)) ([#12037](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12037))
- Completed-turn memory journal counters are delivered before `agent_settled` and `agent_idle`, even when the bounded maintenance observer expires. Journal delivery does not wait for full snapshots, git reads, journal writes or reflection recovery. Late full snapshots preserve newer journal accounting, and unreadable transcripts fall back to durable counters. ([#11935](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11935)) ([#12037](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12037))
- A foreground `task` spawn's running progress updates wait for launch settlement and carry the model the child actually started on (and a start-time fallback's route), instead of publishing incomplete model facts when the launch exceeds 250 ms. Foreground batch rows wait the same way and carry the launched run epoch and route (batch rows do not report `effective_model`). A launch that fails releases the held updates instead of freezing them; pending slot reports remain immediate ([#11693](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11693), fixes [#11691](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11691), [#11827](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11827)). ([#12037](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12037))

### Changed

- Memory command tests avoid redundant hook checks while seeding trusted fixtures, while retaining real hooks for later writes. ([#11954](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11954)) ([#12037](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12037))

### Added

- Add the engine CA importer's launcher trust stage: verify and adopt an inherited generation, or acquire a private generation and exec once with an independent hop bound. A failed import keeps only explicit extras and leaves implicit default inputs closed; child environments regain their original values. This is the launcher increment of the staged rollout, not the transport-error, background-refresh, trust CLI or desktop integration. ([#11956](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11956), part of [#10762](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10762))

name: v5.1.55
body:
**remove-ai-slops now names the two Bun scripts the programming skill ships for test work.** Phase 2 runs `check-test-junk.ts` over every in-scope test file and treats its `file:line` findings as category-9 candidates (never automatic cuts); Phase 4b names `mutation-proof.ts` as the command behind the serial apply/run/restore proof it already described. ([#12017](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12017))

**The programming skill ships two Bun scripts that make the test rules mechanical.** `check-test-junk.ts` flags the junk classes a regex can see in touched test files (source greps, prose pins, fixed sleeps, `.only`/`.skip`, self-comparisons, lower-bound cardinalities) with a per-line opt-out, and `mutation-proof.ts` breaks a production owner, runs the named tests, restores the file byte for byte and prints red/green, so "test your test" is one command. ([#11972](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11972))

**remove-ai-slops now prunes junk tests with the same table the programming skill and the gate reviewer use.** Category 9 marks every in-scope test R/F/C/D, proves each deletion or merge by its class's rule (a production mutation for the behavior classes) before the cut, keeps the retention bar, and reports a baseline-red test as a bug instead of deleting it; behavior is locked with gate-passing tests rather than change certificates, and the report carries a Tests Ledger. ([#11968](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11968))

- senpi-task: a message sent to a daemon task while its launch is being recorded keeps its input identity; the task record no longer rolls its `effect_seq` back, and a record rewritten to the same size is no longer read stale (#10708). ([#11946](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11946))

- Internal telemetry maintenance. ([#11882](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11882))

### Fixed

- `omo remote attach` on Windows now reports a stopped OmO device service as not running instead of a raw connection error (#12042). ([#12043](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12043))
- Memory sync on a CLI sign-in recovers after the OS credential store briefly reads empty (a locked keychain, a racing writer). The operations that saw the empty read are still refused, but the next sync pass gets a live account instead of staying off until restart. A real sign-out or credential change still stops sync (#11812). ([#12001](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12001))
- On Windows, `omo host ensure` forwards a private pipe pair through the npm launcher, Bun re-exec, and provisioned-runtime handoff. Both pipe handles travel together on their original stdio slots, and the waiting launcher closes its owned copies after spawning. Invalid or aliased pairs remain null declarations; POSIX socket forwarding is unchanged. ([#11958](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11958))
- Memory git failures that end without any output now say how the git process ended (exit code, signal and elapsed time) instead of a bare exit code. On macOS and Linux the signal tells an externally killed git apart from a silent git error; on Windows a killed child reports no signal, so there the elapsed time is the only clue. ([#11945](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11945))
- The compiled-worker relocation test no longer hangs now and then. Its fixture waited on `terminate()` from inside the worker's message handler, which races the worker's own exit and never settles on Bun 1.4.4. It now waits for the worker's clean exit after the ready message, and a timeout failure reports its signal. ([#11941](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11941), fixes [#11940](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11940))
- The maintainer `omob` build now compiles the engine trust helper in its own cargo call, as the release workflows do, so a locally built desktop engine matches the released one. ([#11939](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11939), part of [#10762](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10762))
- Validate retained research source bytes before replacing an extraction and preserve the original capture time when reusing those bytes. ([#11936](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11936))
- Memory `/doctor` no longer tells the user to "fix the cause" of parked facts batches without naming it: the facts check now reads as a plain-words to-do (run `/facts retry` for a transient cause such as a timeout, or the named fix such as setting `memory.facts.model`), followed by the cause counts per parked batch and the newest parked batch's run log path, and `/facts retry` reports how many batches it unparked and whether any parked again, with the cause. ([#11909](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11909), part of [#10897](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10897))
- A skill MCP server's `timeout` (milliseconds, set on the server entry in the skill's `mcp` frontmatter or `mcp.json`) now bounds every direct MCP request: list tools/resources/prompts, call tool, read resource and get prompt. Values outside 1 to 2147483647 ms fall back to the SDK default ([#11869](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11869), carried forward from #7224 by @AceRothstein71)

### Changed

- The `omo-ai` installer and launcher no longer rewrite the Claude Code version the engine advertised on Anthropic OAuth requests: senpi removed that request path together with the declaration the rewrite looked for (senpi#5131), so engine preparation keeps only the compile-safe css-tree data and the RPC stream guard, and an engine without the declaration no longer fails preparation with "unsupported Senpi". ([#11964](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11964))
- Simplified OpenCode agent assembly by removing redundant type assertions and an unused builtin-skill name inventory. Agent mode, override precedence, and skill selection remain unchanged. ([#11870](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11870)) ([#11899](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11899))

### Added

- Categories and agents can set `models_distribution: "round_robin"` alongside `models` to spread new task children across their configured model chains. The default `sequential` policy keeps the existing order. Each child's fallback chain wraps from its selected starting model without repeating models, and continuations keep their current model. ([#11905](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11905))
- `omo remote` checks your OmO sign-in first and stops with one plain line when you are signed out, the keychain is locked or the credential store is unavailable (#11853). ([#11864](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11864))
- `omo remote attach <device>/<session>` shows a session from another device of this account in the attach TUI, observe-only for now: input is refused with "remote input not enabled yet" (#11853). ([#11858](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11858))
- `omo remote status | devices | sessions | enable | disable` shows this account's devices and the sessions on them through the OmO device service, as tables or `--json`, with a typed SDK (`@oh-my-opencode/device-service-core`) over the service's local API v1 underneath (#11853). ([#11857](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11857))
- Computer use (macOS): `type()` into a window that shows another computer or device (Screen Sharing, iPhone Mirroring) sends the keys of the current keyboard layout, since such a window receives key codes rather than typed text; every character is mapped before anything is sent, and a character no key types fails `InvalidKey` with nothing typed. In the background, text into a Screen Sharing window that needs Shift or Option fails `BackgroundUnavailable` before the first key (it takes modifiers from the physical keyboard; use foreground delivery), and `el.type()` never inserts into a remote window. ([#11749](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11749), part of [#11466](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11466))
- Command Code is now offered during setup as a custom provider: when `CMD_API_KEY` (or `COMMANDCODE_API_KEY`) is present in the environment, setup writes a keyless models.json provider entry covering both Command Code wires (Anthropic messages and OpenAI-compatible chat completions) and stores the key reference in auth.json, so agents can use Command Code models without manual provider configuration (#11326). ([#11326](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11326))

### Improved

- Simplify agent-usage reminder state reuse without changing reminder caps, delegation suppression or session cleanup. ([#11890](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11890)) ([#11899](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11899))

name: v5.1.54
body:
5.1.53 and 5.1.52 were not published; their changes, listed under 5.1.53 and 5.1.52 below, ship in this release.

**The `programming` skill's Go scaffolder writes LF files on every platform.** A checkout that converts line endings (Windows with `autocrlf`) no longer leaks CRLF into the project it generates; the templates are pinned to LF in `.gitattributes` and normalised on read. ([#11991](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11991))

**The `programming` skill's Python, Rust, and Go project scaffolders run on Bun, so Rust and Go users no longer install uv and typer just to start a project.** `bun run scripts/python/new-project.ts`, `scripts/python/new-script.ts`, `scripts/rust/new-project.ts`, and `scripts/go/new-project.ts` replace the old `uv run ... .py` commands and produce the same files. A missing `uv` or `cargo` now ends with a clear message and exit code 1, and a missing `go` still writes a fallback `go.mod`. ([#11970](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11970))

**The programming skill routes every test file to a testing reference that carries the four-question authoring gate and the junk-test classes.** Writing, reshaping, or deleting a test now loads `references/testing/README.md` (Given/When/Then, the mock ladder, determinism, the prompt-test rule, and a "test your test" mutation step) and `references/testing/junk-classes.md` (the one table of junk classes, retention bar, and R/F/C/D marks that the gate reviewer applies), so a test that would be deleted in review is a test the skill stops you from writing. ([#11967](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11967))

### Fixed

- The release check for the macOS keychain helper accepts a correctly signed helper again: it ignores the `/* exists */` notes `codesign` prints in the designated requirement, and still rejects a different identifier or team (#11980). ([#11981](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11981))

name: CC Switch v4.0.23
body:
# CC Switch v4.0.23

本版本让 Kimi Code、MiniMax Code、Oh My Pi 的供应商编辑器按应用自己的格式显示配置文件里这一家的部分；Claude Code、Claude Desktop 经路由连 OpenAI 格式和 Gemini 的上游时，客户端选的思考档位能发给更多模型，卡片上还可以选怎么发；授权中心可以一键刷新所有账号的额度；Antigravity、MiniMax Code 的用量记录有了耗时和首字时间。另外修复了 Windows 上进入轻量模式后主窗口回不来、经路由连部分 OpenAI 格式的上游时切换模型失败、DeepSeek Harness 的配置目录是链接时无法编辑供应商、Grok Build 超过 50 MiB 的会话用量不统计、Codex 分支会话用量一直不导入、DeepSeek Harness 等应用测试官方余额时提示 Key 为空、供应商表单里几个编辑器互相覆盖等问题。4.0 完整的更新内容请见 [v4.0 发布说明](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.4-zh.md)。

**[English →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.23-en.md) | [日本語版 →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.23-ja.md)**

---

## 新增

### Kimi Code、MiniMax Code、Oh My Pi 的供应商编辑器按原生格式显示

以前这三个应用的供应商编辑器显示的是卡片的 JSON，和它们实际的配置文件对不上，上游文档里的配置片段也贴不进来。现在编辑器只显示配置文件里这一家的部分，位置和格式都和文件一致：

- **Kimi Code**：`config.toml` 里的 `[providers.<key>]` 和它的 `[models."..."]` 表。
- **MiniMax Code**：YAML 里的 `custom_provider.<key>`。
- **Oh My Pi**：`models.yml` 里的 `providers.<key>`。

标题显示实际的文件路径，会跟着目录覆盖和 `KIMI_CODE_HOME` 这类变量变化。草稿有格式错误、写了别家的节点、或者写了 `default_model` 这类全局设置时会提示并拒绝保存，改好之前上方的表单字段暂时不能改，避免把草稿覆盖掉。在编辑器里写的注释不会保存。DeepSeek Harness 的供应商在 profile 补丁里，仍用 JSON 编辑器。

### 经路由连 Gemini 时，思考档位也能发过去

以前 Claude Code、Claude Desktop 经路由转成 Gemini 原生格式时，客户端选的思考档位和「关闭思考」都被丢掉，Gemini 一律用模型的默认设置。现在按 Gemini 自己的 OpenAI 兼容接口的换算方式发：

- **Gemini 2.5**：低、中、高分别是 1024、8192、24576 的思考预算。关闭思考时 Flash 和 Flash-Lite 发 0，Pro 不能关，发最小的 128。
- **Gemini 3 及以后**：发 low、medium、high 档位（Gemini 3 Pro 没有 medium，发 high）。这些模型都不能关闭思考，关闭时发支持的最低档。
- 认不出的模型、图片和语音这类模型、名字里已经带档位的中转别名（如 `gemini-3-pro-high`）不发，请求里本来没有思考设置时也不发。

### 授权中心「全部刷新」

授权中心页头多了「全部刷新」按钮，一次重新查询页面上所有账号的额度（DeepSeek 是余额），各行照常显示更新中（[#9073](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9073)）。

## 改进

**Claude Code、Claude Desktop 经路由连 OpenAI 格式的上游时，思考档位能发给更多模型**（[#9062](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9062)）。以前只有 o 系列、GPT-5 以上和 Grok 4.5 以上会收到思考档位，DeepSeek 等其他模型静默丢掉，日志里也没有记录。现在：

- 认得出的供应商按它支持的档位发，比如 DeepSeek 发 low、high、max，OpenRouter 最高到 xhigh；Kimi、GLM、Qwen、MiniMax 这类 OpenAI 接口不收这个参数的不发。
- 认不出的上游只发 low、medium、high，选 xhigh、max 时发 high。
- GPT-3.5、GPT-4、Llama、Mistral 不发；关掉思考时不发。
- 两个应用的供应商表单在这两种格式下多了「思考档位」：「自动（推荐）」按上面的规则发；「原样发送」客户端选哪档发哪档，上游不支持 xhigh 或 max 时会报错；「不发送」用于上游因这个参数报错的情况。托管账号的卡片不显示这一项。

Codex 经路由连 DeepSeek 时的档位换算也改成和 DeepSeek 官方一致：minimal、low 发 low，medium、high、xhigh 发 high，max 发 max。以前 low 会被提到 high，xhigh 会被提到 max。

**Antigravity、MiniMax Code 的用量记录有了耗时和首字时间。** 以前这两个应用的用量里没有速度和首字时间。以前导入的记录也会补上。

**Skills 的发现页和已安装页改成同一种行样式**（[#9081](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9081)）。仓库名用小号等宽字放在名称旁边，不再显示目录路径；「打开文档」按钮移到最右边；「已安装 · N 个应用」改成「已安装 ›」。从发现页点「已安装」跳过去时，那一行会黄色闪两下再恢复。

**托盘里绑了账号的 Claude 官方卡显示账号**（[#9071](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9071)）。以前副标题都是 `www.anthropic.com`，有好几张官方卡时分不出来。现在有备注显示备注，没有备注显示账号（邮箱，没有邮箱时显示组织名）；账号不在这台电脑上时仍显示官网。

**Claude Desktop 路由模式下，Haiku 档的模型名改成 `claude-haiku-5-5`**（[#9096](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9096)）。Claude Desktop 把 `claude-haiku-4-5` 当成旧模型，Haiku 档选不了思考档位。上游本身是旧版 Claude Haiku 时不改。直连模式不受影响。

**Grok Build 补上了 grok-4.6-build、grok-4.7-build、grok-4.7-build-fast 的价格**（[#9026](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9026)）。

**预设：** 新增 OpenAI API Key 预设、13 家供应商的 Gemini CLI / Antigravity 预设（[#9089](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9089)），以及讯飞 Astron MaaS 按量付费的 Claude Code 预设（[#9036](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9036)）。

## 修复

- **Windows 上进入轻量模式后，再次启动 CC Switch，主窗口不出来，托盘也没反应，重启也没用**（[#9090](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9090)）。
- **经路由连 OpenAI 格式的上游、且上游对非流式请求也返回 SSE 时，切换模型报「Unable to validate model」**（[#9097](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9097)、[#9095](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9095)）。现在非流式请求会收到完整的 JSON 响应。
- **DeepSeek Harness 的 profile 通过符号链接指向同一个文件时，编辑供应商、MCP 一律报冲突**（[#9101](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9101)、[#9100](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9100)）。
- **Grok Build 的会话日志超过 50 MiB 后整个跳过，长会话的用量一直不统计**（[#9026](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9026)、[#6660](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/6660)）。现在逐行读取，之后只读新增的部分。
- **Codex 的分支会话在父会话闲置一段时间后一直不导入，用量统计不到**（[#9093](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9093)、[#9094](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9094)）。
- **DeepSeek Harness、MiniMax Code、Kimi Code 在用量查询里测试官方余额或 Coding Plan 时提示「API key is empty」**（[#9108](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9108)、[#9107](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9107)）。已保存的查询本来就正常，只是测试和自定义模板读不到供应商的 Key 和地址。
- **供应商表单里，改了地址、Key、模型这些字段，再改下方的配置编辑器（或反过来），先改的内容有时被覆盖回去**（[#6777](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/6777)）。
- **启动时界面要等后台的会话用量同步做完才响应**（[#9098](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9098)、[#9084](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9084)）。
- **Codex 经 OpenRouter 用 DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 时，对话里有图片就报 404**（[#6194](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/6194)、[#6176](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/6176)）。
- **Windows 上「本地环境检查」会打开 OpenCode 桌面版**（[#7027](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/7027)、[#6973](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/6973)）。
- **macOS 上添加供应商时，图标选择页的返回按钮被红绿灯挡住**（[#9076](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9076)、[#9075](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9075)）。
- **开着本地路由时，MiniMax Code、DeepSeek Harness 表单里拉取到的模型列表两秒后就消失**（[#9068](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9068)）。
- **MiniMax Code、DeepSeek Harness、Kimi Code 的 Key 输入框用输入法输入时字母重复**（[#9069](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9069)）。
- **用 mise 安装的 Claude Code，在授权中心添加 Claude 账号时报「default installation is ambiguous」。**
- **ChatGPT 登录真的过期时，CC Switch 一直当成临时错误重试，不提示重新登录**（[#9049](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9049)）。同一个 PR 还修了 Gemini 的 `.env` 里 `export` 开头的泄漏凭据清不掉。

---

## 致谢

感谢 @YUZHEthefool（编辑器互相覆盖、启动时界面不等数据库、DeepSeek V4 Flash 图片）、@BingZi-233（编辑器互相覆盖的最初修复）、@allenxu09（Skills 行样式、托盘显示 Claude 账号）、@thisTom（模型列表消失、输入法字母重复）、@1clipse（Codex 分支会话用量）、@kamanager2012（Grok Build 大会话）、@MonsterXia（非流式切换模型）、@yukitakasama（DeepSeek Harness 链接 profile）、@KFCSZYWJ（DeepSeek Harness 余额测试）、@ZeroZ-lab（全部刷新）、@QIN2DIM（图标选择页）、@teddyli18000（OpenCode 桌面版环境检查）、@syxscott（ChatGPT 登录过期、Gemini `.env`、土耳其语）的贡献。

感谢 @noqualia、@acelych、@AlexanderLIBH、@TeaDrink666、@CoolW2077、@Aibeto、@lbigdate、@ayingafu、@tarnish233、@yadenox 报告问题、提供复现信息和修复思路。

特别感谢以下贡献者：你们的 PR 发现并修复了真实的问题，只是同样的问题后来在主线上另行修好，PR 因此关闭。@thynomex（「打开终端」跳过权限确认）、@CupOfBread（图标选择页被红绿灯挡住）、@YUZHEthefool（Grok Build 大会话逐行读取、关于页卡死、额度重置时间、Codex 模型目录）。也感谢 @Owlbay 最早提出把图标选择页改成内容区面板（[#8438](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8438)）。

完整的技术细节请见 [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)。

## Release notes
